source_notes.system: TPQ-37 — מבוסס נתונים פומביים בלבד; רעיוני/חינוכי, לא מפרט אמיתי

assumed_not_published.sensitivity_dbm: calibrated: RCS 0.01 m² -> 30 km (published artillery range)
assumed_not_published.freq_mhz=3250: representative S-band; a third-party database lists 3.11-3.39 GHz
assumed_not_published.gain_dbi=38: not published; only G²/Pmin matters, sensitivity is calibrated
assumed_not_published.prf_hz=2500: chosen so unambiguous range (60 km) exceeds the 50 km range
assumed_not_published.common (all profiles): MDV 20 kt, M/N 2/3, coast 2 s, aspect RCS 0.005/0.02/0.01 m² (shell), boresight 0 — set it to the threat direction after placing the radar
